The pre-Thanksgiving memo comes as the Justice Department has been hit with 97, 000 habeas corpus petition filings since January 2025, including close to 10,000 new petitions filed since October. The five equivalent Democratic committees, meanwhile, raised well over $300 million less than that total but walked away with massive pickups in even traditionally deep red strongholds like Texas, South Carolina, Kansas and Mississippi. Their research documented 2,465 anti-Christian hate crimes and incidents in 2025, with France , England and Wales, Germany and Austria recording the highest totals. "Clergy and people responsible for places of worship were those who were most attacked and also where numbers increased most strongly." CHRISTIAN WOMAN PLEADS NOT GUILTY TO NEW 'ORWELLIAN' CHARGES FOR STANDING AND SILENT PRAYER She added, "These would be people who were present, were visible, recognizable as Christians and kind of associated with a church." Tang noted that while OIDAC’s numbers are "quite conservative," saying "aggression against individuals is highly underreported" across Europe. When the upper chamber returns on Nov. 30, there will be just shy of two weeks for both sides to reach an agreement to thwart another partisan closure. At the center of the issue is the Iran war: Democrats intend to use the government’s purse strings to bring the eight-month conflict to an end. Republicans, meanwhile, want to put together an emergency supplemental funding package with hundreds of billions of dollars dedicated to the military, munitions and war effort. They have, for now, pressed pause on ramming those tax dollars through the party-line budget reconciliation process, and instead are opening the door to work with Democrats. items.summary_original: A man who smiled for a Massachusetts State Lottery photo with a $1 million check was arrested by federal immigration officers days later after a brief foot chase in East Boston. Three ICE sources told Fox News that Ariel Antonio Velasquez-Morales, an illegal immigrant from El Salvador, ran when officers moved in to arrest him early Tuesday but was quickly caught. Multiple officers’ body cameras captured the encounter, the sources said. ICE ARRESTS ILLEGAL IMMIGRANT ACCUSED OF RAPE, MULTIPLE SEX CRIMES AFTER RELEASE FROM MARYLAND JAIL Velasquez-Morales had been wanted by ICE under a final deportation order issued in April 2014, the sources said. He crossed the U.S. border illegally near Roma, Texas, in 2013, according to the sources. MASSACHUSETTS SUES TRUMP ADMIN TO STOP ICE'S COURTHOUSE ARRESTS: 'UNNECESSARY FEAR' The Massachusetts State Lottery awarded Velasquez-Morales the $1 million prize Nov. 18, and posted a photo on Facebook three days later showing him holding the oversized check. The lottery said he bought The Lottery's winning "$2,000,000 50X Cashword" $10 scratch ticket at a market in East Boston , the same neighborhood where ICE arrested him. The Massachusetts State Lottery says anyone 18 or older can buy a ticket from a licensed retailer. The governor appoints two members of the five-member commission that oversees the lottery. Fox News Digital reached out to Massachusetts Gov. Maura Healey’s office and the lottery for comment.

items.summary_original: Excerpts from the late Pope Francis ' private diary published Tuesday reveal that the pontiff endured a two-year spiritual crisis beginning in 2021, writing that he felt tempted by the devil and struggled with the weight of wielding power over the Catholic Church. The 160-page volume, "The Private Diary of Pope Francis," was compiled by Cardinal Victor Fernandez and spans entries from December 1992 through August 2024 — eight months before Francis died in April 2025 at age 88 — marking the first papal diary made public since the 1960s. In a December 2022 entry, Francis described his crisis as "all mixed with governance issues, pressure regarding decisions to make, and aridity and desolation," adding that he resisted becoming a leader "who uses others like puppets." MYSTERIOUS BLOOD-SOAKED RELIC LINKED TO HISTORY'S MOST BELOVED SAINT, ST. FRANCIS OF ASSISI, GOES ON DISPLAY Across the entries, Francis wrote that he believed he had seen the devil three times — including during a Vatican meeting — and recalled a June 2018 vision of hell . "Last night I saw the entrance to Hell," he wrote in the 2018 entry. "I peeked in to look a little, and it terrified me. I grabbed the Rosary as a weapon. I thank the Lord for this help." Reacting Tuesday on "Varney Co.," Fox News contributor and theologian Jonathan Morris said he was most struck not by the late pope's spiritual struggles , but by the Vatican's decision to publish them. "She’s not a communicator," Brown said in an interview with Tara Palmeri, an independent journalist. "No Baptist preacher flavor in her soul," he added. Although Harris remains one of the country’s most recognizable Democratic figures, Brown’s skepticism comes from a longtime political ally and casts doubt on her potential candidacy. DEMOCRATS SHY AWAY FROM QUESTIONS ON WHETHER HARRIS SHOULD RUN FOR PRESIDENT IN 2028 "I’m sorry that she even thinks about running for president. I don’t want her to run," Brown said. "She’s reached the highest electoral level for any woman in America," he added, referring to her post as President Joe Biden’s vice president. Brown, who once served as San Francisco mayor and California state Assembly speaker, has a long history with Harris. Early in her career, he appointed her to the California Unemployment Insurance Appeals Board and then the Medical Assistance Commission. The two were also romantically involved between 1994 and 1995. items.summary_original: Russia is growing increasingly willing to take risks against NATO countries, with a mounting campaign of sabotage, arson attacks and assassination plots that could escalate within weeks or months, Latvia’s president warned in an interview with Fox News Digital. Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs said Western leaders may be underestimating the threat posed by Russian President Vladimir Putin because they fail to fully understand the ideological and historical beliefs driving the Kremlin’s foreign policy. "The appetite for the risk is growing in Russia," Rinkēvičs said. "We see numbers of arson attacks. Some assassination plots. Acts of sabotage." BATTLE-TESTED ZELENSKYY SOUNDS CHILLING ALARM ON WHERE PUTIN’S WAR COULD HEAD NEXT While Russian provocations have so far remained below the threshold that would trigger NATO’s collective defense mechanism under Article 5, Rinkēvičs warned that the situation could deteriorate rapidly. "We see that the number of attacks is rising, but we still see that, at this point, it may change very quickly. It may change maybe in weeks or months or a couple of months' time," he said. The Latvian leader pointed to recent cooperation between Latvian and Estonian intelligence services that he said resulted in arrests in Estonia and prevented an attack against a defense factory. The five were also banned from traveling abroad and engaging in artistic and musical activities for two years. IRAN'S REGIME CAME FOR TEENAGE TWINS. THEIR FATE OFFERS A GLIMPSE OF TEHRAN'S WIDENING DEATH CAMPAIGN One of the defendants’ lawyers told the BBC Monday that efforts to overturn the ruling, reduce the punishment or suspend its enforcement had failed. Defense attorneys also sought to postpone the flogging, but authorities insisted on carrying out the sentence immediately. The punishment sparked outrage among Iranian artists and human rights advocates , who condemned the regime’s restrictions on women and artistic expression. items.summary_original: The politician tasked by Israel's president to form a new government, Gadi Eisenkot, said Monday that Iran poses no immediate threat requiring military action before a new government is formed, drawing a sharp response from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as President Donald Trump considers renewed strikes against Tehran. The dispute comes amid a political power struggle following last month's Israeli election. Netanyahu remains caretaker prime minister, but Eisenkot's allies now control the leadership of the Knesset and key parliamentary committees as negotiations over a new government continue. "Today I see no direct and immediate threat to Israel that requires action before a government is formed," Eisenkot, who previously served as the IDF chief of staff, told his party's Knesset faction, according to an English translation of his Hebrew remarks provided to Fox News Digital. ISRAEL'S POLITICAL SHAKE-UP ENTERS NEW PHASE AS FORMER PM PLAYS KINGMAKER — AND DEADLINE LOOMS He stressed that Iran remains Israel's gravest security threat, particularly its nuclear program. "In my view, the gravest threat from Iran is its stockpile of 440 kilograms of uranium enriched to 60%," Eisenkot said. "It has yet to be destroyed or removed." He called for the material at a minimum to be placed under strict monitoring. Netanyahu pushed back hours later, accusing political rivals of downplaying the Iranian threat for political reasons. items.summary_original: A Russian warship capsized and sank Sunday after suspected Ukrainian sea drones struck a naval base in eastern Libya, triggering an explosion and fire, according to Libyan officials. Hours later, a second drone attack also hit a commercial ship off the coast of Benghazi, Reuters reported. The first ship, the Russian navy corvette Merkury, was docked at Benghazi Naval Base when two explosive-laden sea drones struck the vessel, according to Libyan military officials who spoke to The Associated Press . UKRAINE POUNDS BLACK SEA FLEET’S ‘LAST MAJOR STRONGHOLD’ WHILE PUTIN FLEXES NAVAL POWER IN PACIFIC At least four other drones were intercepted and destroyed, the officials said. Satellite images showed most of the warship capsized and submerged, with only its bow remaining above water. Smoke could be seen rising from the ship's superstructure, and debris was scattered along the pier. Ten people, including Russian and Libyan nationals, suffered minor injuries in the attack and were receiving treatment in Benghazi, medical sources told Reuters. The warship had stopped at the port to refuel and resupply while returning to Russia under a maritime cooperation agreement with Libya's eastern-based government, officials said in a statement. Libyan military officials said an initial investigation indicated that Ukrainian sea drones had been launched from a base in western Libya , according to The AP. UKRAINE STRIKES DEEP INTO RUSSIA’S ARCTIC GAS HEARTLAND AS TRUMP PUSHES PUTIN TOWARD PEACE

"As everyone remembers, I predicted two things concerning the November 3rd Midterm Elections," Trump wrote on Truth Social. TRUMP RESPONDS AFTER VANCE BLAMES IRAN WAR FOR MIDTERM LOSSES, VP SAYS HIS JOB IS TO SUPPORT PRESIDENT "One, that if the Democrats win, the Stock Markets would go down, substantially, which they have, and two, that the Islamic Republic of Iran, which has killed 81,000 protestors as of today, will grow more aggressive in their attacks, which has also occurred. " Trump also said that Iran launched "more drones and missiles over the past week than at any time for over a year," though he said U.S. defenses neutralized the threat. "Don't worry, they've all been knocked down, and done no damage," Trump said. "Iranian leaders consider the Democrats weak, ineffective, and Country destroying, but I won't let that happen!" he added.
